disclaimer: Research only — out-of-sample historical performance does not guarantee future results. This report does not affect live or paper-trading strategy selection.

executive_summary.explanation: The experiment produced 10 out-of-sample trades across 2 test window(s). Key findings: negative net expectancy of Rs -5.97 per trade after costs; profit factor of 0.69 (below 1); the result did not meet the minimum evidence requirement. Final research verdict: INSUFFICIENT DATA. No live or paper-trading behavior is affected by this report.

performance_analysis.gross_return_note: Gross figures are before configured transaction costs.

benchmarks.note: Window returns summed across test windows (each window restarts at the configured capital); the full model line is the compounded overall return.

risk_analysis.risk_of_ruin_note: Rough Gaussian estimate over 25 sequential trades — an approximation, not a measured probability.
warnings: Top five trades generated 87% of total profit — results depend on a small number of trades.

notes: All trades are long-only (no short side in this system).

warnings: Calibration metrics are based on only 10 samples (LOW) — treat with caution.

false_positive_analysis.definition: BUY/STRONG BUY entries that lost money after costs, hit the stop, or never achieved at least +1% favourable excursion.
false_positive_analysis.language_note: Associations only — no causal claims. Example: false-positive trades were more frequently associated with the subgroups showing the largest positive differences above, given sufficient samples.

missed_opportunity_analysis.note: Missed-opportunity analysis unavailable because historical rejected-candidate snapshots were not persisted for this experiment.

feature_analysis.note: Entry-time feature snapshots unavailable — feature analysis limited to Phase 4.2 output.

parameter_sensitivity.note: Sweeps use the stop/target-aware approximation documented in the Phase 4.2 analysis. No single 'best' value is recommended from maximum return alone — prefer stable parameter ranges. Values with VERY LOW / LOW evidence should not drive decisions.

regime_analysis.disclaimer: Analysis-only regime recommendation — not used by live strategy selection.

suggestions.name: Shorter max holding period (10d)
suggestions.hypothesis: Losses grow with holding time in this experiment; earlier exits may cut tail losses.
suggestions.success_criteria: Profit factor >= 1.15 and positive expectancy with >= 100 OOS trades and >= 2 profitable windows.
suggestions.rejection_criteria: Expectancy remains negative or evidence stays below 50 trades.
suggestions.rationale: Holding-period table shows deteriorating expectancy in longer bands (verify in report).

suggestions.name: Shifted window phase
suggestions.hypothesis: Robust results should not depend on window phase alignment.

next_experiments.note: Suggestions follow controlled-experiment principles: one variable at a time, walk-forward evaluation, realistic costs. Queueing always requires explicit user confirmation — nothing is auto-queued.

final_verdict.disclaimer: Even a PROMISING verdict is research-only and does not affect the live system. Never deploy based on this report.

diagnostics.intrabar_rule: Conservative: if stop and target are touched in the same candle, the stop-loss is assumed to trigger first.
